concerns.text: The plan asserts that the full 27 000 Monte‑Carlo replications (including 1 000 replications per grid cell) will complete in ≤ 6 h on a standard GitHub Actions runner (2 CPU cores, ≤ 7 GB RAM). However, for the N = 500 cells the AIPW estimator uses a bootstrap with 200 resamples per replication, which multiplies the computational load by roughly 200× for those cells. This additional overhead is not accounted for in the runtime estimate and is likely to exceed the 6‑hour CPU limit, making the proposed compute strategy infeasible under the free‑compute constraints.
